insights.summary: Unity reported Q2 2026 quarterly revenue of $546.5 million (+24% YoY) with a net loss of $23.6 million, reflecting strategic portfolio rationalization through the exit of ironSource Ads Network and Supersonic game publishing business, which resulted in $279 million in impairment charges in H1 2026. Strong cash generation with $276.9 million operating cash flow despite losses, though the company remains unprofitable with challenged unit economics in its divested businesses. Management maintains a restructuring posture with ongoing headcount reductions and cost optimization while investing in AI/ML capabilities.
keyQuotes: In the first quarter of 2026, we announced we would sunset the ironSource Ads Network, one of our monetization networks, effective April 30, 2026, and we began the process of exiting our Supersonic game publishing business.
We expect that our sales and marketing expense will decrease as a result of the divestiture of the Supersonic business.

We expect our research and development expenses to increase in absolute dollars in the long term, as we invest in new solutions, expand features and functionality with existing solutions, support our artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) initiatives, and enter new markets.

insights.summary: Unity Software reported Q1 2026 revenue of $508.2M (+16.8% YoY) but a GAAP net loss of $347.6M, driven primarily by $279M in impairment charges related to sunsetting its ironSource Ads Network and divesting Supersonic game publishing. The company faces significant headwinds with deteriorating gross margins (31% vs. 74% YoY) and mounting operating losses, though adjusted EBITDA remained positive at $138.3M. Management is in restructuring mode with ongoing workforce reductions and strategic portfolio reset, signaling defensive positioning amid challenging monetization dynamics.
keyQuotes: In the first quarter of 2026, we announced we would sunset the ironSource Ads Network, one of our monetization networks, effective April 30, 2026, and engaged a financial advisor to assist with the planned divestiture of our Supersonic game publishing business.

We expect our existing sources of liquidity will be sufficient to meet our working capital and capital expenditures for at least the next 12 months, including our current intent to settle the principal amount of the 2026 Notes with cash upon maturity in November 2026.

We expect to continue to incur operating losses on a GAAP basis for the foreseeable future due to the investments we will continue to make in research and development, sales and marketing, and general and administrative.
